parsed.why: No criminalisation, hate-crime law covers gender identity, Equality Court enforced relief for a trans prisoner (Nov 2025), functioning recourse. Offset by documented tavern assault, township violence against visible trans women, police mockery and unresolved facility access.

No criminalisation and majority support for equal rights, but no hate-crime or anti-discrimination law, documented police raid with extortion and invented 'homosexuality' charges, no operative LGR path, and persecution tracking political crisis.

Declaration-based recognition, discrimination law covering goods and services, hate-crime aggravating factor for change of sex, case-by-case custody placement without birth-sex rule. No documented trans violence or police abuse; only nonbinary/expression gaps and criticised action plan.

No criminalisation and courts that grant relief (ECtHR HRT damages, nonbinary discrimination ruling), but documented male-facility detention of a trans foreigner with three-month medication cut-off, hate-crime amendments struck down, hostile presidential rhetoric and violent counter-protests.

No criminalisation but no legal recognition at all, documented police harassment at identity checks and arbitrary vagrancy/public-order arrests of trans people, no anti-discrimination or hate-crime recourse, and pervasive social stigma; only asylum procedures name gender identity.
